impact: VAL-CAP-004 row expects "1080p60 monitor capture" but the xdg-desktop-portal delivered format XR24 3840×2160 fps_num=0 fps_den=1 (4K native resolution, variable framerate). Observed diagnostics fps was ~105fps. Even after ISS-001 (harness fps_num=0 fix) is resolved, a 60fps cadence gate would still fail since the actual capture runs at ~105fps 4K. Resolution plan (design pass 2026-05-18, .story/handovers/2026-05-18-04-iss-003-design.md): chosen path D3 — rescope validation to the negotiated matrix cell. The row schema gains additive expectedCaptureFormat (width/height) and expectedEncoderBackend fields (mirroring ISS-001's nominalFps additive pattern). driveValCap004 asserts negotiated sessionReady.format.width × height equals the declared expectedCaptureFormat; mismatch surfaces as a precise ThresholdResult (capture cell matches declared) with passed=false — never a silent pass. deriveThresholdKey keys off the declared cell, not the negotiated cell, so the drop tier reflects row intent. nominalFps source-tracking from ISS-001 is preserved verbatim. No capture-layer or encoder-layer Rust change (per N-003 source-native invariant; per N-008 §18 per-host matrix gate). D1 (constrain PipeWire EnumFormat) rejected — violates N-003 advisory-hint invariant and blocks 1440p/4K cells. D2 (encoder downscale) rejected — re-introduces v1.1.0 fake-60fps regression surface. D4 (declare 1080p60 hardware prerequisite) rejected — documentation-only sidestep that hides mismatch from the per-row report. ISS-002 (encoder.selected via T-017a) remains independent on an orthogonal axis. Next implementation pass: validation-only ticket (recommended name T-021a), allowed files validation/rows.ts + validation/drivers.ts + optionally validation/types.ts and validation/assertions.ts; do-not-touch helper/electron/src/packaging/Cargo/workflow. ISS-003 stays open; flip to resolved happens at end of the implementation pass after a real green per-row report.
title: VAL-CAP-004 capture workload mismatch — portal delivered 4K/variable-fps instead of 1080p60
